name: Social Auth Humanitarian ID
description: Social Auth network plugin for logging in with Humanitarian ID (OAuth via the Social Auth framework).
project_description:
The Humanitarian ID service was decommissioned as of 31 January 2026. 

 Social Auth Humanitarian ID provides Humanitarian ID integration for Drupal 8.

 This module will allow users of your site to authenticate with Humanitarian ID. It is based on Social Auth and Social API projects.

 Humanitarian ID is a service provided to the humanitarian community by UN OCHA, you can read more at http://about.humanitarian.id . We welcome integrations with other sites related to the humanitarian field.
